data/train_v2.csv.role: Supervised model parameter optimization (TF-IDF vectorizer fitting and LinearSVC margin learning)

data/validation_v2.csv.role: Hyperparameter selection (C value, n-gram range, sublinear_tf) and probability threshold calibration

tests/real_world_test_cases.csv.role: Phase 5C qualitative testing and error-pattern discovery (influenced contrastive pair synthesis; must NOT be reported as clean final test)

tests/adversarial_cases.csv.role: Adversarial linguistic robustness checks (negation, unicode, currency)

tests/hard_generalization_v2.csv.role: Initial generalization evaluation; expanded in Phase 6.5 for polysemy stress testing

data/clean_final_test_large.csv.role: Genuinely unseen, held-out independent evaluation set with multi-domain coverage. Never used for feature extraction, training, or threshold tuning.

provenance_verdict: Strict separation established. Phase 5C real-world set is officially designated DEVELOPMENT_TEST. All final metrics are computed solely against CLEAN_FINAL_TEST.
